catalogMeta.label: Say the Answer
catalogMeta.description: Name a displayed symbol or picture, or answer a spoken problem. Recall, not decoding. Show visual naming targets without speaking their names or printing answers.

fullData.title: Word Riddles
fullData.description: Listen to the clues and answer out loud to solve each fun word riddle.
fullData.gradeLevel: kindergarten students (ages 5-6) - Use clear language, relatable examples, foundational skills, and engaging visuals. Encourage exploration and basic problem-solving.

items.ask: I am bright and yellow up in the sky during the day. What am I?
items.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
items.acceptRule: Any clear mention of the sun or sunshine counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying moon or star because they are also in the sky.
items.correctionBody: The answer is sun. The sun shines brightly in the sky during the day.

items.ask: I live in the water, I have fins, and I can swim all day. What am I?
items.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
items.acceptRule: Saying the name of a specific water animal that swims counts as right.
items.signatureError: Saying bird because it lives outside.
items.correctionBody: The answer is fish. A fish lives in the water and swims with its fins.

items.ask: I am a crunchy red fruit that grows on a tree. What am I?
items.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
items.acceptRule: Saying any kind or color of apple counts as the right answer.
items.signatureError: Saying banana because it is also a fruit.
items.correctionBody: The answer is apple. An apple is a tasty fruit that grows on trees.

items.ask: I have four legs, a wagging tail, and I like to bark. What am I?
items.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
items.acceptRule: Saying puppy or hound counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying cat because it is also a common pet.
items.correctionBody: The answer is dog. A dog is a furry pet that barks and wags its tail.
